sourceReview.method: Verified 1-op full-K (K=5120, M=17408, N=1) native Q2_0 HVX vector-matrix projection (hvx_mv_params kernel_type=7, n_hvx=8, n_prefetch=4, src1_row_size=204800, vtcm_size=1912832), lossless PQ2_0-to-HTP_TYPE_Q2_0 scale repetition across both 64-weight tiles per 128-weight block, DSP-side reduction returning a single 69,632-byte F32 output vector per projection, signed v81 HTP op descriptors/solvers in htp_ops.rs, and bounded float tolerance verification (cosineSimilarity >= 0.995, rmse <= 0.5, maxAbsDiff <= 5.0).
sourceReview.scope: Native 1-op full-K Q2_0 projection and signed v81 HTP op descriptors in hexagon-native-rpc, bonsai-hexagon-runtime (NativeQ2Executor), prism-hexagon-model-probe (executionBackend='native-q2'), and bonsai-tools model_device supervisor.

localValidation.singleProjectionNativeQ2ResidentSignedCo: passed 3 logical operations in 3 queue writes across 3 projections (blk.0.ffn_up.weight on tokens 42, 43, 128) with bounded float tolerance pass on all 3 tokens (cosineSimilarity 0.999908-0.999972, rmse 0.0221-0.0286, maxAbsDiff 0.1158-0.1533, top1Match true, top5Overlap 5/5); 1 prepared tensor (25,067,520 bytes in 50,229,248-byte mapping) and 2 cache hits
localValidation.twoProjectionNativeQ2ResidentSignedContr: passed 6 logical operations in 6 queue writes across 6 projections (blk.0.ffn_up.weight and blk.0.ffn_gate.weight on tokens 42, 43, 128) with bounded float tolerance pass on all 3 tokens (cosineSimilarity 0.999906-0.999974, rmse 0.0226-0.0284, maxAbsDiff 0.1286-0.1601, top1Match true, top5Overlap 5/5); 2 prepared tensors (50,135,040 bytes in 75,296,768-byte mapping) and 4 cache hits
localValidation.cleanup: Both controls: four explicit native cleanup return codes zero, allocation freed, required owners pinned until exit, owned Jobs confirmed empty
localValidation.scope: One-projection (blk.0.ffn_up.weight) and two-projection (blk.0.ffn_up.weight, blk.0.ffn_gate.weight) resident native-q2 1-op controls, tokens 42, 43, 128, standard adapter 1.3, NEON/four row workers. No broader arithmetic/lifecycle or production qualification.

diagnosticEvaluationMilliseconds.power: Outer workload clock and all build/control steps observed AC power (acConnected: true, batterySaver: false, 99% battery charge) throughout the 32.256-second run (within the 300-second predeclared allowance). All four arm endpoints in both device controls observed AC connected, battery saver off, and 99% charge. Equal endpoints cannot prove uninterrupted stability.
diagnosticEvaluationMilliseconds.interpretation: Transcoding PQ2_0 weights once at preparation time into llama.cpp's native tiled HTP_TYPE_Q2_0 format with actual FP16 block scales repeated across both 64-weight tiles and dispatching the entire [5120, 17408] projection as a single K=5120, M=17408, N=1 operation (HVX kernel_type=7, n_hvx=8, n_prefetch=4, vtcm_size=1,912,832) reduced NPU shared-memory output traffic from 22.28 MB of 8-bitplane partials per projection to a single 69,632-byte F32 output vector (320x less output traffic per projection, zero host-side bitplane reconstruction). NPU submit-and-wait latency dropped from 22.21-23.48 ms (batch10 40-op bitplane) to 0.6436-0.9832 ms for a single [5120, 17408] projection (35x faster than batch10, 188x faster than 1-op bitplane) and from 44.08-46.26 ms to 1.0821-1.4439 ms (~0.541 ms per projection) for two [5120, 17408] projections (41x faster than batch10, 227x faster than 1-op bitplane, and faster than 4-worker NEON CPU's ~2-3 ms per projection). Across all 248,320 vocabulary logits on tokens 42, 43, and 128, NPU outputs matched CPU control with cosine similarity 0.999906-0.999974, RMSE 0.0221-0.0286, exact top-1 token agreement (1183, 12, 248), and 5/5 top-5 token overlap.

defaultBlockers: The published CPU Prism runtime and server have no NPU serving integration. Changing the descriptive admission lock alone cannot enable offload.
The experimental session is terminal, at most 120 seconds, 128 MiB mapped shared buffer (at most 4 resident 25.07 MB FFN projections), and 24,000 logical operation attempts.

Full-layer or multi-layer FFN offload requires expanding resident shared-memory capacity beyond 2 projections and batching chained ops (such as SwiGLU / RMSNorm or multi-projection packets) to amortize FastRPC queue wakeups across all 40 layers.
Broader arithmetic/history, native ownership/lifecycle, persistent recovery, packaging/isolation and release acceptance remain incomplete.
nextConcreteImplementation: Evaluate multi-op packet chaining (e.g., ffn_up + ffn_gate + SwiGLU + ffn_down with VTCM intermediate residency via OP_PASS_KEEP_DST_IN_VTCM / OP_PASS_READ_SRC0_FROM_VTCM) and multi-layer resident weight arena scaling so an entire FFN block or multiple layers execute per queue submission.
